reason: I have one apartment next to my house, Booking and Airbnb already send my messages, and the guests have the printed rules sheet. If they need something they knock on my door, so I don't see why I would pay €35 every month plus €150 for this.
objection: I already have this covered for free, and I don't trust a new one-person company to talk to my guests. If the robot tells them something wrong, the bad review is mine.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbour with one apartment like mine using it for a whole season, with no mistakes and better reviews, and a price closer to €10 a month only in the summer months.
